_about: The studio's games. CubePix and Orbit Dash have their own worlds on the page (src/index.html); «more» are the cards under «More from Lewydo», in this order. Texts: game.<id>.genre and game.<id>.d in src/i18n/<lang>.json → site. Addresses: each game lives on its own subdomain of lewydo.com (since 06.11.2026: cubepix.lewydo.com, orbitdash.lewydo.com) — another origin than the studio page, so every address here is absolute, and every link to a game carries the studio mark and ?lang= (tools/build.mjs, src/lang.js). A new game: its icon (192 px) and banner (800 px wide) → python3 tools/webp.py … assets/games/, an entry here, its two strings in every language, npm run build. A game updated (version, design, features, languages, icon) → its world here and its words, in the same task (CLAUDE.md, «Гра оновилась»).

_since._about: The live «time since» timers (src/index.html, «since»): each counts calendar years · months · days (+ a ticking hh:mm:ss) from its start day, 00:00 UTC, to the visitor's clock now. The one place for these dates — change a date only here. Format yyyy-mm-dd.

orbitdash._trails: The twenty-two ball trails of Orbit Dash 5.0, the game's order without the seasonal WISP (names are never translated): bought with gems — rarity by price (c common, r rare ≤ 900, e epic ≤ 1 500, l legendary), m — earned by clearing a music level (the Demon levels' own legendary trails too: CAPE, KEYS, INFERNO, MESMER), x — won on RANKS only (FLARE, 2.2). 4.0 added INFERNO (THE FABULOUS), PETAL (SUNSHINE), PRISM (CHROMA); 5.0 — MESMER (HYPNOTIC, legendary) and MIRAGE (ABRACADABRA), the SPECIAL levels.
